text:
Rae Kim: quick draft 1 copy/pasteable customer action card + ops notes for accounts showing renewal friction. want one-paragraph and a tiny checklist.
Jonas Feld: paste it so SAs can grab.
Rae Kim: ```Customer action card:
Please run 3 representative prompts with prefill_tokens=1000, spacing=10s, 2 repeats each to warm the assistant. After warmup, share these metrics: redwood.latency.p95, redwood.cache.hit_ratio, redwood.errors.rate. If p95 > 800ms or cache_hit_ratio < 0.60, we will execute a targeted prefill and schedule a 30m triage within 72h.```
Priya Shah: two small adds: include telemetry keys (cs.request_id, cs.model_variant, cs.stream_gap_ms) and a one-line email snippet for SAs. also note: if quality drops, gently revert to previous full-precision variant while investigating.
Rae Kim: added. one-line email snippet: "Hi <Name>, we warmed your assistant—please reply with overall helpfulness (0-10) and paste redwood.latency.p95 + redwood.cache_hit_ratio. If helpfulness <=5 we'll book a 30m triage."
CS Bot: reminder 1 add runbook /repos/cs/runbooks/renewal-action-card.md label: "renewal-play".
Rae Kim: thanks — I'll publish and post a TL;DR in #account-health.
